s1.syndrome_frame: Neurologic syndrome with intractable hiccups and leptomeningeal enhancement
salient_findings: Diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement on brain MRI
Lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features in cerebrospinal fluid
key_facts: 73-year-old man presented with intractable hiccups
Past medical history of chemotherapy and autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplant
Normal complete blood cell counts after transplant
Afebrile with normal vital signs
Normal neurologic examination except for hiccups
Brain MRI showed diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement and enhancement of several cranial nerves
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features
Flow cytometry showed κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation

raw.syndrome_frame: Neurologic syndrome with intractable hiccups and leptomeningeal enhancement
salient_findings: Diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement on brain MRI
Lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features in cerebrospinal fluid
key_facts: 73-year-old man presented with intractable hiccups
Past medical history of chemotherapy and autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplant
Normal complete blood cell counts after transplant
Afebrile with normal vital signs
Normal neurologic examination except for hiccups
Brain MRI showed diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement and enhancement of several cranial nerves
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features

shortlist.label: Lymphomatous meningitis
shortlist.why_kept: Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features and flow cytometry showed κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation

shortlist.label: Primary central nervous system lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Brain MRI showed diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement and enhancement of several cranial nerves, consistent with CNS lymphoma

shortlist.label: Neurolymphomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Intractable hiccups and leptomeningeal enhancement on MRI, with a history of chemotherapy and autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplant

shortlist.label: Waldenström macroglobulinemia
shortlist.why_kept: Lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features in cerebrospinal fluid and κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation

shortlist.label: Mantle cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of chemotherapy and autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplant, with lymphocytosis and plasmacytoid features in cerebrospinal fluid

raw.rationale: The presence of lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features in the cerebrospinal fluid and flow cytometry showing κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, along with diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement on brain MRI, strongly supports the diagnosis of lymphomatous meningitis, which is characterized by the infiltration of lymphoma cells into the leptomeninges.

rejected.label: Primary central nervous system lymphoma
rejected.why: While this condition involves lymphoma in the CNS, the key finding of leptomeningeal enhancement and lymphocytosis in the CSF points more specifically to lymphomatous meningitis.

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: This condition involves infiltration of lymphoma into the nervous system, but the specific findings of leptomeningeal enhancement and CSF lymphocytosis are more characteristic of lymphomatous meningitis.

rejected.label: Waldenström macroglobulinemia
rejected.why: This is a type of lymphoma that involves the production of high levels of IgM, but the flow cytometry results and clinical presentation do not specifically support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Mantle cell lymphoma
rejected.why: While mantle cell lymphoma can involve the CNS, the specific findings in this case, including the κ light chain restriction and plasmacytic differentiation, do not specifically point to mantle cell lymphoma as the most likely diagnosis.
